purpose: Additional repositories not used to develop this review correction; reported separately from the repeated development cases. Selected before viewing their new findings, regardless of development rerun outcome. No claim that the historical project never used these repositories.
selection: Smallest SHA-256(seed + NUL + case id) per language among dataset repositories other than the three development repositories.
scoring: Current one-to-one class/location matcher; same precision floor, exact-content judgment provenance.
sampling: Twenty off-list findings with smallest SHA-256(seed + NUL + finding key) per language, or every finding when fewer; all negative-control findings are judged separately. Unknown findings are never counted as true.
